projectDescription: An Android concert hall ticketing app with seat selection, session management, and a PHP/MySQL backend API for managing concerts, reservations, and user accounts.
keyFeatures: Interactive seat map with zone-based pricing
Seat availability states (available, selected, reserved, unavailable)
Shopping cart with multi-seat selection and total calculation
Session/showtime browsing filtered to future dates
Event calendar view with concert sessions
User registration and login with hashed passwords
Transactional reservation confirmation with concurrency control
Bottom navigation with Home, Calendar, Profile, and Menu tabs
PHP REST API backend with MySQL database
publicApiSurface: POST /login.php — Authenticate and retrieve user info
GET /obtener_sesiones.php?id_concierto={id} — Get upcoming sessions for a concert
GET /obtener_butacas_sesion.php?id_sesion={id} — Get seats and their states for a session
GET /obtener_calendario.php — Get upcoming calendar events with concert and session details
POST /confirmar_reserva.php — Create a reservation for selected seats (transactional)
